source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Encapsulation with its Tidbit (PDF 39, printed 35).

blocks.text: Encapsulation OOP ka woh concept hai jis mein data (variables) aur methods (functions) ko aik unit, yani class, mein band kar diya jata hai aur data tak seedhi pohanch (direct access) rok di jati hai.

Java ya C++ jaisi languages ki tarah Python mein "private" ya "protected" jaise sakht keywords nahi hain. Python naam rakhne ke tareeqe (naming conventions) se batata hai ke data ko kaise istemal karna chahiye.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Data ko chhupayein aur us tak pohanch sirf methods ke zariye dein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Encapsulation ko ek dawai ke capsule ki tarah samjhein: dawai (data) capsule (class) ke andar band hai, aur aap usay seedha haath nahi lagate. Class ke methods hi data tak pohanchne ka rasta hain.

items: Encapsulation: data aur methods ek class mein band, data tak seedhi pohanch mehdood.
Python mein private/protected keywords nahi; naam rakhne ke riwaj (naming conventions) se kaam hota hai.
